_comment: Per-block RECOMMENDED sizes (pixels) for the character-sheet blocks, plus the GM window's own blocks (gm_*). Keyed by block. These are not constraints: the grid is user-resizable, so a number here is the size a block reads well at, and nothing stops anyone dragging a block smaller. It is used for exactly three things — the size a block opens at, the soft detent a divider sticks at on its way past, and the mark shown during a drag (with the 'fit to content' that snaps back to it). Omit a dimension (or set it to null/0) to state no opinion, and the block opens at whatever its own content asks for; abilities and resistances say nothing in either dimension because their tables report their real columns and rows, which is more honest than a number a denser or roomier preset would make wrong. There are no maxima any more: pinning a block's width was how the old page stopped Abilities being stretched, and a page whose columns the user drags has no use for it. The old min_width/min_height names are still read as the recommendation, for mods that ship a blocks.json written against them. These are the baseline: the active theme's 'blocks' map overrides any of them, since how much room a block needs depends on the look's density.
